entries.note: Serialize copy/write/rename/commit so failed writes do not appear accepted in memory. Window links survive GUI closure and constrain report direction to the origin/project pair. Retrying an identical sender/window/key returns its original sequence; changed content rejects. The originating agent may report its own project-side findings, with reportedByRootId retaining actual attribution. Reports are bounded stored data, never fetched references, executable commands or provider prompts.

Use negative request IDs so production control replies cannot collide with positive fixture automation IDs. Bound buffered responses and timeouts; process exit rejects pending requests. Inspection strips the global workspace state and writes optional snapshots only to supervisor-chosen local paths. No PTY input or arbitrary command is accepted by this interface.
